*DpnI/MboI check for Plasmid FS, F1 (293T20knuc) FS samples*

Samples to be processed:

- Gcla- no Hia5  
- HAP1 HRS- 12  
- HAP1 HRS- 18  
- HepG2 HRS- 12  
- HepG2 HRS- 18  
- 293T 20k no Hia5  
- F1 (293T20knuc)

To prepare the reactions:

| DNA | 10 ng |
| :---- | :---- |
| rCutsmart Buffer | 1 uL |
| DpnI/MboI | 0.2 uL |
| Total  | 10 uL |

DpnI

| 37 C | 1 hour |
| :---- | :---- |
| 80 C | 20 mins |

MboI

| 37 C | 1 hour |
| :---- | :---- |
| 65 C | 20 mins |

DpnIMboI master-mix:

7 uL rCutsmart \+ 1.4 uL DpnI/MboI \+ 54.6 uL NF H2O

Split 9 uL per tube and add 1 uL DNA (corresponding to 10 ng).

*SBP Beads preparation*

Remove storage buffer from SBP beads (on magnet). Then resuspend the beads in 40 mL Blocking buffer and incubate at RT, 20-30 mins. Remove buffer.

SBP: 2.5mL beads in 55mL blocking buff(salt free), dist 5 plates, 25uL/wel → Prepare 2 NUNC plates.l

*SBP Histone Octamer Plate*

Octamer concentration \= 7.25 ug/uL \= 7250 ng/uL

Number of experiments \= 12

Volume per experiment \= 1.8 uL

Volume needed per well \= 22 uL

Prepare 30 ng/uL octamer with 25 uL per well ⇒ 25 X 400 X 35 \= 300 ug SBP-octamer

Take 41.4 uL of original octamer and make up solution to 10000 uL (add 9958.6 uL of refolding buffer:glycerol (1:1))

Add 833 uL per well of a 96-well storage plate. From here use the Beckman robot to first add 104 uL per well of same 96-well plate & then finally aliquot this to 25 uL per well in a single 4ti384-well plate.
title: Prepare SBP-Octamer stock plate for NCFS & 1st round NCAP-SELEX
